description: This file contains the implementation of an auto-embed plugin for a lexical editor, including configurations for embedding YouTube videos and Tweets, React components for the embed menu, dialog, and the plugin logic itself.

classes.name: PlaygroundEmbedConfig
classes.description: Interface extending EmbedConfig with additional properties like contentName, icon, exampleUrl, keywords, and description.

classes.name: AutoEmbedOption
classes.description: Class representing an option in the auto-embed menu, with a key and optional behaviors.

methods.name: AutoEmbedMenuItem
methods.description: React component rendering a single menu item for the embed options.

methods.name: AutoEmbedMenu
methods.description: React component rendering the list of embed options.

methods.name: debounce
methods.description: Utility function to debounce input callback calls.

methods.name: AutoEmbedDialog
methods.description: React component providing the dialog for inputting URLs and triggering embed actions.

methods.name: AutoEmbedPlugin
methods.description: Main React component that integrates the auto-embed functionality into the lexical editor, managing modal display and menu interactions.
